name: azdo-secure-chat
description: End-to-end encrypted team chat extension for Azure DevOps Server and Services

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('tests/build/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node --test tests/mentions.test.mjs tests/integration.test.mjs && node tests/fuzz.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs azure-devops-extension.json --output-path ./bin
scripts.package:dev: npm run build:dev && tfx extension create --manifest-globs azure-devops-extension.json --overrides-file configs/dev.json --output-path ./bin
